violations.raw_html_snippet: <input class="form-control" id="cardholder-name" placeholder="Cardholder Full Name" type="text"/>
violations.issue_explanation: Form control <input> lacks an accessible programmatic label (<label for='...'>, wrapping label, or aria-label). Relying solely on placeholder='Cardholder Full Name' violates WCAG 3.3.2 because placeholders disappear on user input and are not reliably announced by all screen readers.
violations.before_html: <input class="form-control" id="cardholder-name" placeholder="Cardholder Full Name" type="text"/>
violations.after_html:
<label for="cardholder-name" class="form-label">Cardholder Full Name</label>
<input class="form-control" id="cardholder-name" placeholder="Cardholder Full Name" type="text"/>
